title: Earth?
content:

Earth is from the Real Life and is the third planet from the solar system and has a moon named "moon". It has over 200 cities of huamans and ants.

It was created during the big band which rocked the solar system and earth into existence, earth was very uninhabitable at first. A mars sized huaman named sarpy then crashed into the earth forming a ring that would eventually collapse into the moon "moon". Eventually the earth cooled down until life was able to form.

jerald is often associated with the world's creation and is implied to have created it by speaking it into existence.

The first instances of prebiotic life was bacteria and viruses, bacteria back then were far simpler than they are now, and eventually advanced enough into fungi over a large period of time, homo erectus and homo sapian however developed from the weaker version of them; bacteria. Viruses kill bacteria in order to make more viruses, and over time they would be able to advance into coronaviruses that were able to punch humans and kill to make more of themselves. There is evidence to suggest that there used to be a stronger virus called "smallpox" but humans defeated that one a long time ago and now experiment on it. It is not known what fungi evolved into but considering they're rarely talked about it's assumed they evolved into the dinosaurs.

Images of ancient civilizations worshipping jerald

6 million years ago, the dinosaurs were born and they roamed the earth eating all plants and animals like monkeys and giraffes, while they roamed the surface, homo erectus and homo sapian lived in caves and made stone tool. Around 500 years later, a giant rock from space called "Chicksxulub Impactor" crashed into the surface and killed them all with the help of some volcanoes, homo erectus and homo sapian survived in caves and emerged to take over the world, homo erectus and homo sapian fought and homo sapian won, eventually homo sapians would advance into humans, thousands of years passed and the camera was discovered, the first photo being of an ant.

ancient egyptians worshipped gods such as Jerald and rombito, who reside in present day spaghettiverse,, they are very mysterious and possibly created earth initially. It is said the pyramids were built in Jerald’s honor.

farming was first started by an old woman Eve, farming soon spread to every ocean and even aquatic humans started learning farming to feed themselves. fishing also became a popular past time due to lack of mobiles.

other developments were the national aeroplane space and astrologer commision of US (NASA for short) which successfully tested a asteroid deflection rocket which deflected an asteroid from orbit and thereby saved earth.

Earth also has a poisonous chemical oxygen and green colored objects called trees which produce oxygen from carbon dioxide, they also produce dihydrogen monoxide, a dangerous chemical that kills ants and causes acid rain, it is also found commonly in cancer cells, the first instance of this liquid was when several rocks rained from the sky in the orange times and broke apart into water, a very dangerous compound with the highest pH of any other acid at a whopping 7;
